usedFor: ikas holds store orders and customers, and Zendesk Support holds tickets, so “New Order” can run “Create Support Ticket”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in ikas, then “Create Support Ticket” in Zendesk Support
bestTemplate.why: Each order can open a ticket with requester, priority and tags set, so support has the order context.

watchOut: “Order Updated” in ikas fires on each change to an existing order, so one order can open several tickets.
